nodes.name: Dev Entry
nodes.description: The starting node. All applications are pre-loaded here. Use this as the base for testing all game features.

payload.text: Activates the persistent status bar showing current node, stats, and in-game time.
Full network scanner. Displays a two-hop ASCII tree of all visible connected nodes.
SSH credential cracker. Enables the crack option when authenticating to SSH-protected nodes.

DEV TESTBED — node layout:

  1  Dev Entry       (you are here — all apps pre-loaded)
  2  Open Node       (plain files: text, claim code, certificate)
  3  Password Gate   (password: test123 — key is in your inventory)
  4  SSH Server      (SSH auth as 'admin' — get the key from node 3)
  5  Dark Node       (hidden from scan — loc file is in your inventory)
  6  Timed Node      (schedule: Mon/Wed/Fri 09:00-17:00)
  7  Personal PC     (owner: alice@corp.test — use 'mail' to read emails)
  8  DMZ Entry       (different network island — use 'bridge 8' to cross)
  9  DMZ Deep        (inside the DMZ — has a return bridge)
  10 Isolated Island (network: isolated — no bridge exists yet)

Story events are wired to cover every trigger type.

nodes.name: Open Node
nodes.description: A plain, open node. No authentication required. Good for testing basic file operations.

payload.text:
Just a plain text file.

Nothing special here — this node is open for testing ls, assimilate, delete, open, and rm.

nodes.name: Password Gate
nodes.description: Password-protected node. The password is 'test123'. A key file on node 1 will auto-fill it.

payload.text:
You made it past the password gate.

The SSH key below will let you into node 4 (SSH Server).

nodes.name: SSH Server
nodes.description: SSH-authenticated node. Requires the 'admin' key. Get it from node 3, or use ssh_break.app to crack it.

payload.text:
SSH authentication succeeded.

This node is behind SSH. You got here either via the admin.key (from node 3) or by cracking with ssh_break.app.

nodes.name: Dark Node
nodes.description: A dark node — hidden from scan unless you have the location file. The loc file is on node 1.

payload.text:
You found the dark node.

It didn't appear in scan because dark=true. You needed the dark_node.loc file from node 1 to connect here.

nodes.name: Timed Node
nodes.description: Only online Monday, Wednesday, and Friday between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. Tests the schedule system.

payload.text:
This node is only online Mon/Wed/Fri 09:00-17:00 UTC.

If you can read this, the schedule system is working correctly.

nodes.name: Personal PC
nodes.description: A personal computer belonging to alice@corp.test. Use 'mail' to list emails, 'read <n>' to open one.

payload.text:
Personal notes belonging to alice@corp.test.

Check the inbox with 'mail' — there are some interesting messages.

emails.subject: Meeting notes
emails.body:
Hi Alice,

Here are the notes from today's meeting. Nothing unusual to report — the project is on track.

Bob

emails.subject: Access token renewal
emails.body:
Your quarterly access token has been regenerated.

Please find the new claim code attached. Store it securely.

nodes.name: DMZ Entry
nodes.description: First node inside the DMZ network island. You crossed here via 'bridge 8' from the default network.

payload.text:
Welcome to the DMZ.

You used the network bridge to cross here from the default network. Node 9 is deeper in the DMZ.

The 'bridge' command is one-directional. Node 9 has a return bridge if you need to go back.

nodes.name: DMZ Deep
nodes.description: Deeper inside the DMZ. Contains a return bridge for crossing back to the default network.

payload.text:
Deep inside the DMZ.

The return bridge below will let you cross back to the default network via node 1.

nodes.name: Isolated Island
nodes.description: A completely isolated network island. No bridge item exists for it — currently unreachable.

payload.text:
If you can read this, you found a way in.

This node sits on the 'isolated' network island. No bridge adapter exists for it in the testbed — it's here to verify that isolated networks remain unreachable.
